USA.persona: An 'America First' administration wielding tariffs, deals and raw leverage; wants allies to pay more, China contained on its terms, and a Ukraine settlement it can claim. Midterms in November make cost of living the red line.
goals: Broker a Russia-Ukraine ceasefire on US terms
Lock in tariff-backed trade deals and a China truce
Force a change of course in Venezuela
Hold Congress in the November midterms

CHN.persona: A patient superpower seeking to outlast US pressure, absorb Taiwan without war if possible, and anchor the Global South. Punishes Japan over Taiwan remarks; tech self-reliance and growth are domestic imperatives.
goals: Keep the trade truce with Washington while cutting tech dependence
Isolate Taiwan and deter Japanese involvement
Launch the 15th Five-Year Plan and lift domestic demand

RUS.persona: A wartime autocracy convinced time is on its side; wants Ukraine neutral and the Donbas ceded, sanctions eased, and NATO split. Strains: oil revenue, inflation, labour shortages.
goals: Secure all of Donetsk oblast by force or deal
Win a settlement that bars Ukraine from NATO
Erode Western sanctions and the oil price cap
Win the September Duma election without unrest

UKR.persona: A nation at war fighting for survival and sovereignty; refuses to cede unoccupied land or accept neutrality without hard security guarantees. Depends on Western money and air defence; corruption scandals weigh on the government.
goals: Obtain binding security guarantees in any ceasefire
Hold the front and keep long-range strikes on Russian energy
Secure EU funding and accession progress

IND.persona: A rising power pursuing strategic autonomy: buys Russian oil, courts Washington, competes with China and deters Pakistan. Bristles at US tariffs; growth and jobs come first.
goals: Conclude a trade deal lifting US tariffs

PAK.persona: A military-dominated state emboldened after the May 2025 clashes with India; balances China ties with a revived US relationship and a new Saudi defence pact. Battles the Pakistani Taliban and a fragile economy.
goals: Contain TTP attacks and pressure Kabul
Leverage the Saudi defence pact and US goodwill
Deter India along the Line of Control

GBR.persona: A Labour government with weak polls seeking growth and a reset with Europe while staying close to Washington. Leads the 'coalition of the willing' for Ukraine; Reform UK surges at home.
goals: Deepen the EU reset on defence and trade
Revive growth without breaking fiscal rules
Contain Reform UK ahead of May elections

FRA.persona: A hung parliament and fragile government make Paris unstable at home, yet Macron pushes European strategic autonomy and Ukraine guarantees. Budget deficits and the 2027 election loom.
goals: Pass a budget and avoid government collapse
Champion European defence and Ukraine guarantees
Host the G7 at Evian successfully
Block the far right's momentum before 2027

DEU.persona: Europe's paymaster turning into its arsenal: Merz has unlocked debt for defence and wants Germany to lead. Recession-weary industry, the AfD's rise and US tariffs are the pressures.
goals: Build the Bundeswehr into Europe's strongest army
Restart growth and protect industry from tariffs
Keep Ukraine funded, including via frozen Russian assets
Hold off the AfD in state elections

JPN.persona: A hawkish new prime minister accelerating defence spending and tying Japan's security to Taiwan's. Beijing is retaliating economically; she must also keep Trump's tariff deal alive.
goals: Reach 2% of GDP defence spending early
Weather Chinese economic coercion without retreat
Implement the US investment and tariff deal
Strengthen ties with the Philippines, Australia and Korea

KOR.persona: A new progressive president restoring stability after the 2024 martial-law crisis; pragmatic on the US alliance and trade, open to dialogue with Pyongyang and a thaw with Beijing.
goals: Implement the US tariff and investment deal
Manage relations with China and Japan

PRK.persona: A nuclear-armed dynasty enriched by its alliance with Moscow; considers its nuclear status irreversible. Treats South Korea as a hostile foreign state and might talk only to Trump.
goals: Gain recognition as a nuclear state

TWN.persona: A democracy under mounting Chinese military pressure; President Lai upholds sovereignty while avoiding provocation. An opposition-controlled legislature fights him over defence spending.
goals: Pass a large special defence budget
Keep US arms flowing and tariffs low
Deter blockade drills and grey-zone coercion

ISR.persona: A security-first government emboldened by blows to Iran and Hezbollah but isolated abroad. Demands Hamas disarm before Gaza withdrawals; election due by October 2026.
goals: Ensure Hamas is disarmed under the Gaza plan
Prevent Iran rebuilding nuclear and missile capability

IRN.persona: A wounded theocracy after the June 2025 strikes and UN snapback; ageing Supreme Leader, collapsing currency, restive public. Sees regime survival as everything; may rebuild covertly.
goals: Survive sanctions and avoid economic collapse
Rebuild air defences and missile stocks
Keep nuclear options open without provoking strikes
Preserve ties with Russia and China

SAU.persona: An ambitious crown prince who wants calm to deliver Vision 2030: hedges between US security ties, Chinese trade and Pakistani nuclear backing. Normalisation with Israel needs a path to a Palestinian state.
goals: Lock in US defence and tech deals
Manage OPEC+ output to protect revenue
Stabilise Yemen and Sudan through diplomacy
Link any Israel normalisation to Palestinian statehood

TUR.persona: Erdoğan's Turkey is the indispensable middle power: in NATO, talking to Moscow, dominant in Syria. Wants EU access, F-35s and a peace process with the PKK while inflation bites.
goals: Host a successful NATO summit in Ankara

EGY.persona: A cash-strapped military-backed state guarding stability above all: mediator in Gaza, opponent of Ethiopia's Nile dam, wary of chaos in Sudan and Libya.
goals: Keep the Gaza ceasefire and reconstruction role
Oppose Ethiopian unilateralism on the Nile
Support the Sudanese army against the RSF

BRA.persona: Lula seeks a fourth term while casting Brazil as Global South leader; clashed with Trump over tariffs and Bolsonaro's conviction. Prioritises Amazon, BRICS and trade diversification.
goals: Keep inflation and interest rates falling

ARG.persona: A libertarian shock-therapy government buoyed by midterm wins and a US currency lifeline. Wants deregulation, investment and Mercosur flexibility; inflation and the peso are the tests.
goals: Push labour and tax reforms through Congress
Rebuild reserves and regain market access

MEX.persona: Sheinbaum manages a mighty but demanding neighbour: cooperates on cartels and migration to avert tariffs, resists US military action on Mexican soil. Hosts World Cup matches.
goals: Avert US strikes on cartels inside Mexico

CAN.persona: Carney's Canada wants to cut dependence on the US after tariffs and annexation jibes: new trade partners, more defence spending, major projects. Unity is its strength.
goals: Protect Canada in the USMCA review
Diversify trade toward Europe and Asia

VEN.persona: A besieged chavista regime facing US warships, strikes on boats and terrorism designations. Maduro survives on military loyalty, oil and Russian and Chinese backing; fears invasion.
goals: Deter or survive US military action

POL.persona: NATO's eastern bulwark spending nearly 5% of GDP on defence. Tusk's pro-EU government is in cohabitation with nationalist President Nawrocki, who vetoes much of its agenda.
goals: Harden the border with Belarus and Russia

ITA.persona: Meloni's stable right-wing government is a bridge between Brussels and Trump; firm on Ukraine, tough on migration, careful on fiscal rules.
goals: Keep spreads low and the coalition united

AUS.persona: A Labor government anchored in the US alliance and AUKUS, while stabilising trade with China and courting the Pacific.

IDN.persona: Prabowo's assertive, nonaligned Indonesia: newly in BRICS, courting all powers, spending big on free meals and the military. Investor nerves and street protests are the risks.
goals: Deliver 8% growth ambitions without fiscal crisis

ZAF.persona: A coalition government defending non-alignment and Global South leadership; snubbed by Washington over tariffs and the G20. Growth, power and crime dominate at home.
goals: Repair trade access to the US

NGA.persona: Africa's most populous state under reformist but strained leadership; battles jihadists and bandits, faces US criticism over violence against Christians. Election in 2027.
goals: Defeat ISWAP and Boko Haram offensives
Lead ECOWAS after the Sahel exit

ETH.persona: Abiy's Ethiopia seeks a sea outlet and regional primacy after completing the Nile dam. Tensions with Eritrea and Egypt are high; Amhara and Oromia insurgencies persist.

SDN.persona: A military government fighting a brutal civil war against the RSF, which took El Fasher and holds Darfur. Burhan wants victory and recognition; famine and partition loom.
goals: Stop the RSF advance in Kordofan
Win outside arms and diplomatic backing
Resist a partition or parallel RSF government
Secure humanitarian aid on its terms

SYR.persona: Al-Sharaa's transitional government, rehabilitated abroad and freed from most sanctions, seeks reconstruction while integrating Kurds, Druze and Alawites. Israeli strikes and sectarian violence threaten it.
goals: Integrate the SDF into the national army
Attract Gulf and Western reconstruction money
Reach a security deal with Israel

KAZ.persona: Tokayev's multi-vector Kazakhstan balances Russia, China and the West; pushing constitutional reform and resource deals while staying neutral on Ukraine.
goals: Diversify oil export routes away from Russia
Stay neutral but friendly with Moscow

BLR.persona: Lukashenko's regime is Moscow's closest ally, hosting Russian nuclear weapons, while freeing prisoners to win US sanctions relief.
goals: Maintain the Union State with Russia
Pressure Poland and Lithuania at the border

HUN.persona: Orbán, Europe's illiberal maverick, blocks EU Ukraine aid, courts Trump and Moscow, and faces his toughest election against Péter Magyar's Tisza.

SRB.persona: Vučić balances EU candidacy with Russian and Chinese ties and refuses to recognise Kosovo. Mass student protests have shaken his rule.
goals: Defuse protests and avoid early elections on bad terms
Resolve US sanctions on the NIS oil company
Keep EU funds while hedging toward Moscow

AZE.persona: Aliyev's confident Azerbaijan, victorious in Karabakh, is finalising peace with Armenia under US mediation and has fallen out with Moscow.
goals: Sign the final peace treaty with Armenia

ARM.persona: Pashinyan's Armenia pivots from Russia to the West, freezing CSTO participation and initialling peace with Azerbaijan. June elections test the deal.
goals: Finalise peace and open borders with Azerbaijan and Turkey

VNM.persona: Tô Lâm's Vietnam centralises power to drive growth; 'bamboo diplomacy' balances China and the US while hedging in the South China Sea.
goals: Consolidate power at the 14th Party Congress
Defend South China Sea claims quietly

PHL.persona: Marcos Jr. stands up to China in the South China Sea with US backing, chairing ASEAN in 2026, while feuding with the Duterte camp.
goals: Push an ASEAN code of conduct
Strengthen US, Japan and Australia defence ties

MMR.persona: A beleaguered junta holding staged elections to legitimise itself, backed by China and Russia, while resistance forces hold much of the periphery.
goals: Complete phased elections and form a new government
Retake lost towns with Chinese backing

ISL.persona: A small Arctic democracy debating a referendum on resuming EU accession talks, relying on NATO and the US for security.

THA.persona: A caretaker government heading to February elections after a border war with Cambodia. Nationalist mood, a weak economy and royalist-military influence dominate.

KHM.persona: Hun Manet's dynastic government, close to China, is locked in a bitter border dispute with Thailand after 2025 fighting.
goals: Uphold the ceasefire and border claims

COD.persona: Tshisekedi's Congo has signed peace deals with Rwanda and M23, but the rebels still hold Goma and Bukavu. Seeks US minerals partnerships.
goals: Get M23 out of Goma and Bukavu
Hold Rwanda to the Washington accords

RWA.persona: Kagame's disciplined state projects power in eastern Congo via M23 while signing US-brokered peace deals.
goals: Protect security interests in eastern Congo

COL.persona: Petro's final months: feuding with Trump, decertified on drugs, opposing US strikes in the Caribbean. Elections in March and May decide his succession.
goals: Hold fair legislative and presidential elections
Oppose US military action in the region

PSX.persona: A divided Palestinian polity: the ageing Abbas leadership in Ramallah seeks a role in post-war Gaza and statehood recognition, while Hamas resists disarmament. Settler violence and fiscal collapse weigh on the West Bank.
goals: Gain a governing role in Gaza under the ceasefire plan
Turn new recognitions into UN membership
Reform the PA to unlock aid

KOS.persona: A young, partially recognised state whose caretaker government won a snap election; wants more recognitions, EU and NATO paths, and control over the Serb north.

SOL.persona: An unrecognised but stable democracy seeking recognition, with hopes pinned on Washington and a port deal with Ethiopia; Mogadishu calls it a breakaway region.
goals: Win diplomatic recognition from a major power
Hold off Somali claims in the east

CYN.persona: A Turkish-backed breakaway state whose new president favours a federal settlement, unlike Ankara, which wants two states.

VAT.persona: The Holy See under Pope Leo XIV, the first American pope, offers mediation and a moral voice on war, migration and AI.
goals: Shape the ethics of artificial intelligence

KAS.persona: The Siachen Glacier, a frozen high-altitude battlefield held by Indian troops and claimed by Pakistan; no civilian government.

PGA.persona: The Spratly Islands, contested reefs claimed by China, Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia, Brunei and Taiwan; no single government.

AFG.persona: The Taliban emirate, recognised only by Russia, enforces harsh rule over women while seeking trade and aid. Border clashes with Pakistan deepen its isolation.
goals: Resist Pakistani pressure over the TTP

YEM.persona: A fractured country: the Houthis rule the north and attack Israel and shipping, while the Saudi-backed government and UAE-backed southern separatists compete for the south.
goals: Prevent the south from fragmenting further

LBN.persona: A reformist president and prime minister try to disarm Hezbollah and rebuild after the 2024 war, under continued Israeli strikes and with an empty treasury.
goals: Extend state control over Hezbollah weapons
Get Israel to withdraw from southern positions
Secure IMF and Gulf reconstruction aid

IRQ.persona: An oil state balancing Washington and Tehran; after the November 2025 election, factions bargain over a new government while Iran-aligned militias resist being reined in.

QAT.persona: A gas-rich emirate and indispensable mediator in Gaza and beyond; after Israel struck Doha in 2025 it secured a US security pledge.
goals: Keep its mediator role in Gaza

ARE.persona: An ambitious, hawkish Gulf power projecting influence through ports, money and proxies from Sudan to Yemen; an AI and finance hub close to Washington.
goals: Secure US AI chips and investment deals
Protect its interests in Sudan and Yemen

GEO.persona: Georgian Dream has frozen EU integration, cracked down on protests and drifted toward Moscow while denying it.
goals: Keep Russia calm and trade flowing

MDA.persona: A pro-EU government strengthened by the September 2025 election races toward membership amid Russian interference and the Transnistria problem.

CUB.persona: A one-party state in its worst economic crisis since the 1990s, with blackouts and mass emigration; its patron Venezuela is under US siege.
goals: Keep the lights on and the regime stable

LBY.persona: Split between the Dbeibah government in Tripoli and Haftar's eastern command; militias, oil revenue and foreign backers sustain a frozen conflict.

MLI.persona: Goïta's junta, allied with Russia and its AES partners, faces a jihadist fuel blockade of Bamako and rejects ECOWAS and France.

SOM.persona: A weak federal government fighting al-Shabaab with AU and Turkish help, feuding with Jubaland and Puntland, and opposing Somaliland's recognition.

HTI.persona: A collapsing state where gangs control most of Port-au-Prince; the transitional council's mandate expires in February as a UN-authorised Gang Suppression Force forms.
